principles: Reuse the existing derive+persist machinery (deriveFindingSignalsFromStore + writeFindingSignals); add no new derivation or storage path.
Advisory only: the single write is the materialHash-excluded learning cache; no gate, no finding, no scoring/promptHash change.
Correct classification: a cache-writing command is L2 experience-layer (not read-only), registered consistently incl. process-fact-levels.
Faithful snapshot: scan persists all derived signals; staleness filtering stays at read time.
Prove the loop end-to-end: a test must show hints go from empty (pre-scan) to firing (post-scan).
drivers: Activating advisory hints without touching any gate or determinism.
Keeping the new command consistent across every registry the process-fact contract checks.
Demonstrating the activation effect, not just that a file was written.

options.name: Thin CLI over deriveFindingSignalsFromStore with projectRoot (chosen)
pros: Minimal surface: reuses the proven, already-tested derive+persist path.
No new storage code; learning-store remains the only toucher of .lattice/learning/.
Deterministic and easy to smoke-test end-to-end (scan then hint-fires).
cons: Recomputes all signals each run (acceptable: small data, out-of-band maintenance command).

options.name: New bespoke scan+persist path
pros: Could add scan-time filtering or incremental update.
cons: Duplicates derivation/storage logic; risks divergence from the read path.
Scan-time filtering is explicitly out of scope; incremental update is premature.

options.name: Auto-scan on a hook (no explicit command)
pros: Cache could stay fresh without an operator step.
cons: Hidden writes during gated flows risk surprising state changes; harder to reason about and test.
An explicit, auditable command is clearer for a first activation slice.

chosen: Thin CLI over deriveFindingSignalsFromStore with projectRoot (chosen)
rationale: A thin command over the existing, already-tested derive+persist path is the smallest correct way to activate the hint cache; it adds no new storage logic, keeps learning-store the sole cache writer, and is straightforward to verify end-to-end (hints empty before, firing after). The bespoke and auto-hook options add scope or hidden writes that this first activation slice does not need.

preMortem.scenario: learning_scan writes the cache but hints still never fire.
preMortem.trigger: The handler passes a project-root that differs from the one the hint loader reads, so the cache lands at a path the loader does not consult.
preMortem.consequence: The story claims activation but the loop stays inert — the central deliverable silently fails.
preMortem.mitigation: Use the same root the handler context/store exposes; the smoke runs scan THEN the hint loader against the same root and asserts a non-empty hints section (empty before, firing after).

preMortem.scenario: The new command breaks the project-wide process-fact contract.
preMortem.trigger: learning_scan is added to cli-engine/config but not to PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS, so the process-fact-contract suite in npm test fails (as happened on B-a2e3).
preMortem.consequence: DONE is blocked late by the full npm test fallback.
preMortem.mitigation: Add the L2 experience-layer entry to PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS in the same change; the verifier runs the full npm test and asserts process-fact-contract passes; run npm test before REVIEW.

preMortem.trigger: It is copied from learning_validate and accidentally added to READ_ONLY_COMMANDS or given ownershipClass readOnly, despite writing the cache.
preMortem.consequence: Its cache write is omitted from the activity audit trail and the command is mislabeled, misleading future contributors.
preMortem.mitigation: Explicitly classify it as a writing L2 experience-layer command; verifier asserts it is NOT in READ_ONLY_COMMANDS and command-policy ownershipClass is not readOnly.

preMortem.scenario: Writing the cache dirties the worktree and blocks a gate.
preMortem.trigger: finding-signals.json is written somewhere not covered by the materialHash exclusion.
preMortem.consequence: git-working-tree / evidence-freshness gates trip on the cache file.
preMortem.mitigation: Persist only via writeFindingSignals under .lattice/learning/ (already materialHash-excluded); the verifier asserts no tracked source file changes from running the scan.
